h1: Black Friday Ad Creatives You Can Prepare Weeks Ahead
lead: Plan a Black Friday creative set around featured products and placements, then add confirmed offer details after download.
card: Clips and banners made ahead, with every size ready for sale weekend.
secondary_keywords: Black Friday sale ads for ecommerce
intro: Keep the featured product clear and leave a separate area for the offer. Add the confirmed discount, code, and end date in an editable text layer.

AIVideosUGC lets you make the visual side well ahead of time: vertical and square product clips (6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds long) and square banners with bold backgrounds and space for your deal. Prices, countdowns and "doorbuster" labels go on later in CapCut or Ads Manager, so you can lock in the visuals before your discounts are final.

ideas.t: Clip with room for a countdown
ideas.d: A vertical clip that leaves the top of the frame clear, so you can add a timer in your editor.
Several of your products arranged as a set for a holiday bundle deal.
A second visual in a different color and setting, so Monday's ads don't look like a rerun of Friday's.

plan.d: Choose the products you'll feature, clean up their photos, and try early versions in your regular ads to see which visuals people stop for.
Make the final clips and banners in each size, add the offer text, and submit ads early to leave time for platform review; timing and approval depend on the platform.
Schedule everything, keep spare versions for Cyber Monday, and swap out anything that isn't getting clicks.

faq.q: How early should I make my Black Friday ads?
faq.a: Several weeks ahead gives you time to try a few versions and leaves room for ad review. Because prices go on afterward, you can finish the visuals before your discounts are settled.

faq.q: Can you add a countdown timer to my video?
faq.a: No. Add the countdown in CapCut or with your ad platform's own tools, where you control the exact end time.

faq.q: Do I need a separate video for each platform?
faq.a: Usually a 9:16 version covers TikTok, Reels and Stories, and a 1:1 version covers the feeds. Each one is its own generation, with its credit cost shown up front.

faq.q: Which Black Friday details should stay editable until the offer is final?
faq.a: Keep the price, discount, code, and end date editable until they are confirmed. Add them after download so you can update the wording without rebuilding the product scene.

overview.h2: Make the product win the first glance
overview.d: Black Friday creative can be dramatic without hiding what is being sold. Use contrast, one hero product, and a single visible action—a lid opens, a bundle is arranged, or a lamp switches on. Keep the offer as a separate layer so the visual can be approved before the percentage, code, or final date is locked.

overview.h2: Choose a video frame shape for each placement.
overview.d: AIVideosUGC offers 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4 video shapes, with 9:16, 1:1, and 16:9 covering the main phone, feed, and wide placements. Video choices are 6, 10, 15, and 30 seconds, and the cost is shown before each job. Make a new composition when the crop changes what the shopper can see; do not stretch one frame into every placement.

input_guide.h2: Start with a sale-ready product photo

items.d: Use a photo where the product's silhouette and most important feature are obvious before the seasonal styling is added.
Describe dark stone, deep fabric, metallic paper, or another real setting that supports the product without filling every corner.
Ask for open space at the top or side, but add the actual price, percentage, code, and deadline in your editor later.

results.h2: A seasonal set with clear roles

items.d: One product or bundle against a bold background, with a quiet area reserved for your exact offer.
A 9:16 clip that shows the product in use and keeps the top or center open for text you add later.
A 1:1 composition that remains recognizable when the viewer scrolls past quickly.

scene_recipes.h2: Black Friday prompts with room for the deal

items.d: A black coffee machine stands on a dark counter with a narrow highlight along its edges and clean space above.
A real set of candles, matches, and a small tray is arranged on deep fabric, with each item visible from the front.
A ribbon-tied box opens on a dark table and reveals the product without any generated words on the lid.
A watch or piece of jewelry turns slowly under a single light, with the top third left quiet for your final-day message.

after_download.h2: Apply the Black Friday details yourself

items.d: Type the discount, price, code, and end date in Canva, CapCut, or Ads Manager, then compare them with the live offer.
Inspect 9:16, 1:1, and any wide version in its actual placement so the product and message stay visible.
Use a countdown or last-chance phrase only when the deadline and inventory support it.
Retire files that show an expired deal before reusing the underlying scene for another promotion.
